review_candidates.title: Senior Database Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: We're looking for a Senior Database Engineer who's responsible for developing, standardizing, automating, and optimizing enterprise-wide database solutions used by Database Support and business teams. Candidates must have at least 5 years of Senior DBA experience followed by 5 years in Database Engineering within large-scale enterprise environments. Responsibilities Develop and maintain automated database builds and standardized images across Oracle, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MySQL, and MS SQL Server
